title: Steelworks Landing Page Reveal
description: On-load preloader and hero reveal: a white progress bar scales across a dark overlay that wipes away via clip-path, five small rotated images glide in as a centered row with CustomEase, then the side images fly off-screen while the center one expands to a fullscreen hero as nav, headline and social links reveal line by line with SplitText masks.

images.desc: extreme close-up of a machined brushed-steel surface with concentric turning marks, cool graphite tones and one warm highlight
single cast-aluminium sculptural stool on a seamless graphite studio backdrop, soft directional light, editorial product shot
flagship shot: a monolithic cast-metal designed object in a dark studio, dramatic raking side light, deep shadow filling the lower-left, warm off-white fall-off upper-right
images.role: center image that scales to fullscreen hero background

images.desc: matte-black machined aluminium hardware detail on a warm graphite backdrop, clean studio light with a subtle brass rim
foundry material study — cooling cast-metal billets with a warm amber glow against deep shadow, atmospheric
